text:
Predicates:
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton.
KnownAs(ailtonSilva, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva is commonly known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
Brazilian(ailtonSilva) ∧ FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(nautico) ∧ FootballClub(braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(flu) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
∃y (FootballClub(y) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, y)) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to a football club.
